In commission in Forder Creek, Saltash, Cornwall

Heron is a 2006 Memory 19 by Salterns of Poole. Substantially built in grp with teak woodwork and pine sole boards.

She is a fully rigged topsail gaff sloop

Since purchasing her in 2018 I have carried an extensive programme of maintenance and upgrading (see schedule for full details) including:

| | | | - |- | | New Mast(Columbian pine) | 24/08/18 | | New standing rigging | 24/08//8 | | Covers | 05/08/20 | | New laminated Tiller | 02/04/21 | | Tohatsu outboard (2nd hand) – remote tank | 15/04/21 | | Sails – Peter Crockford Sailtech | 14/08/20 | | Oars 8ft and rowlocks | 26/10/20 | | Depth sounder, battery and solar panel | 20/07/20 | | Compass | 05/07/19 | | New running rigging | 2020 |

Other improvements include: Engine control arm, 2nd jib fairleads for small jib, Jammers and turning blocks to jib, jamming block for mainsail, down haul handy billy, improved reefing and topping lift to enable easy reefing at sea.
